scope: TYP-71 iOS onboarding privacy consent with 1.0.2 reminder preservation

checks.name: Onboarding handoff iPhone SE UI
checks.command: xcodebuild test -project ios/Hanco/Hanco.xcodeproj -scheme Hanco -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone SE (3rd generation),OS=26.5' -only-testing:HancoUITests/HancoUITests/testOnboardingSelectsLevelBeforeFirstInputAndRoutesToForcedHatchMissions

checks.name: Privacy and legacy upgrade iPhone SE UI
checks.command: xcodebuild test -project ios/Hanco/Hanco.xcodeproj -scheme Hanco -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone SE (3rd generation),OS=26.5' -only-testing:HancoUITests/HancoUITests/testPrivacyParticipateEnablesBothChoicesAndNoticeIsShownOnce -only-testing:HancoUITests/HancoUITests/testPrivacyContinueWithoutSharingDisablesBothAndRevisitReusesButtons -only-testing:HancoUITests/HancoUITests/testLegacyUpgradePreservesDisabledReminderAndContinuesPrivacyFlow -only-testing:HancoUITests/HancoUITests/testPrivacyDefaultTypeFitsWithoutScrollingOnPhoneAndIPad

checks.name: Privacy consent iPad layout UI
checks.command: xcodebuild test -project ios/Hanco/Hanco.xcodeproj -scheme Hanco -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPad Pro 13-inch (M5),OS=26.5' -only-testing:HancoUITests/HancoUITests/testPrivacyDefaultTypeFitsWithoutScrollingOnPhoneAndIPad

manual_gates: Physical-device OS notification prompt and production telemetry transport verification remain release QA; archive, upload, App Store Connect, Android, and TYP-43 release work were explicitly out of scope.
